scene.note: Tonight's kit and route sit at the top of batteries.py, and your sums turn them into batteries, packs and a walking time.

steps.note: Dougie has a number of head torches, and each takes the same number of batteries.
Under Task 1 one sum gives the batteries for every torch.
The result is a whole number of batteries, kept in its own variable.
Batteries come in packs of the same size.
Under Task 2 a division counts only the packs that are completely full.
The answer is a whole number of packs, never a part of one.
Some batteries may be left once the full packs are filled.
Under Task 3 one operator gives what is left over after dividing.
Dougie takes the full packs and the loose batteries, and opens no pack too many.
The walk in has a distance and the team walks at a steady speed.
Under Task 4 the distance divided by the speed gives the hours, rounded to one place.
Rhona gets a walking time to plan with, instead of a guess.
